info.title: GoWay realtime socket
info.description:
The WebSocket between goway-realtime and the driver and client apps, described from the server's side: frames
the apps send are `receive` (From the app), frames the server sends are `send` (To the app).

Every frame is a JSON object `{"type", "data"}`; frames from the server also carry `ts` (RFC 3339 UTC), and
`ping` and `go_offline` may leave `data` out. The server may add frame types at any time: ignore a frame whose
`type` the app does not know, and never fail or drop the socket over one.

## Connecting

1. Open `wss://<api host>/realtime/v1/ws` and send `auth` with the access token within 5 seconds. Send the
   `installation_id` the device was registered under too: removing that device then closes this socket on its
   own, while without it only an account-wide sign-out does.
2. A revoked or stale token gets an `error` frame and the socket closes.
3. On success the server answers `connected`; a second `auth` on the same socket is ignored.

The server pings every 30 seconds and closes a socket it has not heard from for 75 seconds. Reconnect with
jittered backoff, send `auth` and `go_online` again, and re-read state over REST: the socket is a wake-up signal,
and frames sent while the app was away are not replayed.

## Offers

- A driver gets offers while online on a line, with an approved carrier, a vehicle whose truck class and loading
  method match the load, a wallet in good standing, no active booking and a live socket.
- An offer goes to every eligible driver on the line at once. The first accepted claim wins; the others get
  `offer_result` with `withdrawn`, which costs them nothing. Nobody is offered the same load twice.
- One pending offer per driver. It expires at `deadline_at`, and an expired offer is not a decline.
- The line is saved in goway-auth (`PUT /v1/carrier/line`: regions, return direction, truck; a limited number of
  changes a day). `go_online` takes no parameters and stays on until `go_offline` or a lost connection; changing
  the line while online moves the driver to the new queue and repeats `online`.
- After a disconnect the driver keeps presence and queue position for the offline grace window (90 seconds by
  default).
- Locations are relayed only during an active booking, and sampled as delivery evidence every 30 seconds by
  default.

production.description: Public entry; the proxy forwards `/realtime/v1/ws` to goway-realtime.

socket.title: App socket
socket.description: One socket per signed-in app session.

payload.title: AuthFrame
payload.description: Frame `auth` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: Auth
data.description: The first frame on a new socket, within five seconds: the access token.

installation_id.description: The app install's id, the one the device was registered under; lets this socket be signed out on its own when the device is removed.

payload.title: PingFrame
payload.description: Frame `ping` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: Ping
data.description: Nothing: an empty object, or no `data` at all.

payload.title: GoOnlineFrame
payload.description: Frame `go_online` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: GoOnline
data.description: Start receiving instant offers on the line saved with `PUT /v1/carrier/line`, with its vehicle.

payload.title: GoOfflineFrame
payload.description: Frame `go_offline` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: GoOffline
data.description: Leave the line. Nothing to send: an empty object, or no `data` at all.

payload.title: LocationFrame
payload.description: Frame `location` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: Location
data.description: The driver's position. Relayed to booking viewers and sampled as evidence only while a booking is active.

heading.description: Degrees from north, when the device knows it.

speed.description: Speed the device reports, when it knows it.

payload.title: OfferResponseFrame
payload.description: Frame `offer_response` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: OfferResponse
data.description: The driver's answer to an instant offer.

payload.title: SubscribeBookingFrame
payload.description: Frame `subscribe_booking` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: SubscribeBooking
data.description: Watch a booking of the caller's organization: status, arrival window and the driver's position.

payload.title: UnsubscribeBookingFrame
payload.description: Frame `unsubscribe_booking` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: UnsubscribeBooking
data.description: Stop watching a booking.

payload.title: ConnectedFrame
payload.description: Frame `connected` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: Connected
data.description: The `auth` frame was accepted; the socket is live.

worker.description: The goway-realtime worker holding the socket, `<host>-<pid>-<suffix>`; for logs.

config.title: ConnectionConfig
config.description: Current realtime settings the app plays by.

offer_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a driver has to answer an offer.

offer_grace_seconds.description: Extra seconds after the deadline a late answer is still honoured.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: PongFrame
payload.description: Frame `pong` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: Pong
data.description: The answer to `ping`; nothing in it.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: OnlineFrame
payload.description: Frame `online` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: Online
data.description: The driver is on their line: after `go_online`, and again whenever the line is changed while online.

bidirectional.description: The way back is taken too.

vehicle_id.description: The truck the offers are matched against.

queue_position.description: Place in the outbound line's queue, from 1.

offers_blocked.description: Set when the wallet blocks offers, with the reason; null otherwise.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: OfflineFrame
payload.description: Frame `offline` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: Offline
data.description: The driver left the line: after `go_offline`, or taken off it with a `reason`.

reason.title: OfflineReason
reason.description: Why the server took the driver off the line; absent when the driver left by themselves. `vehicle_unavailable`: the line's truck was removed, left the fleet, or the line has none.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: OfferProposedFrame
payload.description: Frame `offer_proposed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: OfferProposed
data.description: An instant load offered to this driver; answer before `deadline_at`.

deadline_at.description: Answer deadline, unix milliseconds in server time.

pickup_address.description: First pickup stop's address as the shipper wrote it; null only when the load has no stops.

dropoff_address.description: Last drop-off stop's address; null only when the load has no stops.

distance_km.description: Driving distance through the stops; null when routing was unavailable at posting.

duration_min.description: Driving time for the same route in minutes; null together with the distance.

pickup_distance_km.description: Straight-line distance from the driver's last position to the pickup; null while the position is unknown.

pickup_from.description: Earliest pickup; null when not given. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

pickup_to.description: Latest pickup, also the posting's expiry; null when not given. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

cargo_category.description: Cargo type code from the reference catalogue.

loaders_count.description: Loaders the shipper ordered with the truck.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: OfferResultFrame
payload.description: Frame `offer_result` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: OfferResult
data.description: How an offer ended for this driver.

booking_id.description: Sent only when the outcome is `won`; null when goway-loads' answer could not be read.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: SubscribedFrame
payload.description: Frame `subscribed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: Subscribed
data.description: `subscribe_booking` was accepted.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BookingCreatedFrame
payload.description: Frame `booking_created` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the booked driver. It currently forwards the internal `booking.created` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

data.title: BookingCreated
data.description: A load was booked. Two paths: an accepted offer, or an instant claim from dispatch, which adds `source: instant`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

driver_user_id.description: The driver; the offer path allows null, a booking always has one.

agreed_amount.description: Agreed price, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

source.title: BookingSource
source.description: Present only for an instant claim from dispatch; an accepted offer leaves it out.

shipper_user_id.description: The person who posted the load; they hear `booking_created` on the socket too.

pickup_from.description: Earliest pickup; null when not given. A pickup well ahead makes this booking a plan rather than a trip under way.

pickup_to.description: Latest pickup; null when not given.

duration_min.description: Driving time of the haul in minutes; null when routing was unavailable.

busy_from.description: Start of the span this booking keeps the driver busy, goway-loads' plan buffer included. Dispatch offers the driver nothing whose trip overlaps it.

busy_until.description: End of that span; null when the haul's duration is unknown, which keeps the driver busy until the booking ends.

plan.description: The driver booked a plan: a load scheduled ahead, taken from the plan list.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BookingStatusFrame
payload.description: Frame `booking_status` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the driver and to the booking's viewers. It currently forwards the internal `booking.status_changed` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

data.title: BookingStatusChanged
data.description: The carrier moved the haul one step on: `en_route`, `at_pickup`, `loading`, `in_transit` or `delivered`. Completion and cancellation have their own subjects.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

occurred_at.description: When the step happened: the driver's tap, which an app offline for a while sends late. Steps arrive in order; this is the time to show.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BookingEtaFrame
payload.description: Frame `booking_eta` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the booking's viewers only, and dropped when a socket is slow. It currently forwards the internal `booking.eta_updated` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

data.title: BookingEtaUpdated
data.description: The arrival window or the time the truck is free again moved: when the haul is booked (`confirmed`), at every carrier step, and on fresh GPS while `en_route` or `in_transit`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

eta_stop.description: Which stop the window is for; null when no arrival is expected any more.

eta_from.description: Earliest expected arrival at `eta_stop`; null with it. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

eta_to.description: Latest expected arrival at `eta_stop`; null with it. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

free_at.description: When the truck is expected to be empty again. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

free_region_id.description: Where the truck will be free: the drop-off region; null when unknown.

truck_class.description: The booked vehicle's truck class code.

remaining_km.description: Road kilometres left to the next stop; null before the haul sets off or while routing is unavailable.

last_waypoint.description: The last region boundary the truck crossed, for «Angrendan o'tdi · 142 km qoldi»; null until it crosses one.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BookingCompletedFrame
payload.description: Frame `booking_completed` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the driver and to the booking's viewers. It currently forwards the internal `booking.completed` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

data.title: BookingCompleted
data.description: A delivered haul was closed: by the shipper, by an operator, or by the auto-complete sweep. All three send the same fields. Billing charges its commission from this event.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

agreed_amount.description: Price agreed at booking, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

settled_amount.description: What the haul actually settled at: the agreed price unless another sum was confirmed, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

completed_at.description: When the haul was closed; the code allows null, it is always set. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

completed_by.title: CompletedBy
completed_by.description: Who closed the haul: `carrier` when the driver finishes it at the drop-off, `system` for the auto-complete sweep.

items.title: ChargeLine
items.description: One priced line of the haul.

amount.description: Line total, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

charges.description: Price lines; the first is always the agreed tariff.

waiting_minutes.description: Billable minutes the driver waited at pickup.

waiting_amount.description: What the waiting costs, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

waiting_billable.description: Whether the waiting is charged to the shipper.

total_amount.description: Charges plus waiting, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); the code allows null.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BookingCancelledFrame
payload.description: Frame `booking_cancelled` goway-realtime sends to an app. Sent to the driver and to the booking's viewers. It currently forwards the internal `booking.cancelled` event as-is, so `data` is that event's payload, `event_id` and organization ids included.

data.title: BookingCancelled
data.description: A booking ended before the cargo was loaded. The load goes back to the board. Two paths send the same fields: either side cancelling (`by` is `shipper` or `carrier`) and an operator (`by` is `operator`).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

reason.description: What the canceller wrote; empty when nothing was written.

driver_user_id.description: Null when no driver was assigned.

plan.description: The cancelled booking was a plan.

penalized.description: The cancellation counts against the driver's acceptance rate: the driver's own cancellation of an instant haul, or of a plan later than goway-loads' free-cancel window before pickup, or an operator's cancellation of a booking whose driver never showed up. False for every other shipper and operator cancellation.

reason_code.description: Code from the cancellation reasons catalogue; null for older clients and system cancellations.

fee_amount.description: Cancellation fee the shipper owes the carrier, whole so'm (`cancel_fee_percent` once the driver set off); null when none.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: DriverLocationFrame
payload.description: Frame `driver_location` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: DriverLocation
data.description: The booked driver's live position, relayed to the booking's viewers as it arrives; dropped when a socket is slow.

heading.description: Degrees from north; null when the driver's device did not send it.

speed.description: Null when the driver's device did not send it.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: VerificationChangedFrame
payload.description: Frame `verification_changed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: VerificationChanged
data.description: The carrier's verification moved; the app re-reads `GET /v1/carrier/verification` for the note.

status.title: VerificationStatus
status.description: The new verification status; `expired` when an approved document ran out.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: OffersBlockedFrame
payload.description: Frame `offers_blocked` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: OffersBlocked
data.description: The wallet stopped being eligible; no offers until it is settled.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: OffersUnblockedFrame
payload.description: Frame `offers_unblocked` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: OffersUnblocked
data.description: The wallet is eligible again after being blocked; nothing in it.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: NotificationFrame
payload.description: Frame `notification` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: Notification
data.description: Something landed in the user's notification feed; refresh the badge. Copied from `notification.created`; a field that event lacked or sent empty arrives as null.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: SessionStartedFrame
payload.description: Frame `session_started` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: SessionStarted
data.description: Somebody signed in to this account; ignore it when `installation_id` is this app's own. Copied from `user.login`; a field that event lacked or sent empty arrives as null.

at.description: When the sign-in happened, as `user.login` wrote it.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: KickedFrame
payload.description: Frame `kicked` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: Kicked
data.description: This socket is being closed by the server; sign in again.

reason.description: `device_removed`, `logout` (closed from another device), the `user.session_revoked` reason, or what a service passed to `/internal/kick`; null when none was given.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: ErrorFrame
payload.description: Frame `error` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: FrameError
data.description: A frame was refused; the same problem shape as REST errors. Two forms are sent: a first frame that is not `auth`, an unreadable frame and a refused booking subscription send only `code` and `key`; every other refusal sends the full problem body with `type`, `title`, `status` and `code`, plus `detail`, `key` and `params` when set.

code.description: Stable code the app branches on.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

data.title: Conflict
data.detail: No pending offer for this load

payload.title: SearchProgressFrame
payload.description: Frame `search_progress` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: SearchProgress
data.description: To the shipper while their instant load is being offered: how many drivers have seen it.

seen.description: Drivers the load was offered to so far.

started_at.description: When the search began; the app counts the waiting time from it.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: SearchExhaustedFrame
payload.description: Frame `search_exhausted` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: SearchExhausted
data.description: To the shipper: no driver took the load within the search window. The search goes on; the app offers to raise the price, move the pickup to a plan or cancel.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: SubscribeBoardFrame
payload.description: Frame `subscribe_board` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: SubscribeBoard
data.description: Hear when loads on a lane appear, change or leave the board, for a live plan list. One direction per frame; a driver with a way back subscribes to both.

payload.title: UnsubscribeBoardFrame
payload.description: Frame `unsubscribe_board` an app sends to goway-realtime.

data.title: UnsubscribeBoard
data.description: Stop hearing about a lane.

payload.title: BoardSubscribedFrame
payload.description: Frame `board_subscribed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: BoardSubscribed
data.description: `subscribe_board` was accepted.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BoardLoadAddedFrame
payload.description: Frame `board_load_added` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: BoardLoadAdded
data.description: A load appeared on a subscribed lane: newly posted or back after a cancelled booking. A signal; the app reads the list again over REST.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BoardLoadUpdatedFrame
payload.description: Frame `board_load_updated` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: BoardLoadUpdated
data.description: A load on a subscribed lane was edited: price, pickup window or note. A signal; the app reads it again over REST.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BoardLoadRemovedFrame
payload.description: Frame `board_load_removed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: BoardLoadRemoved
data.description: A load left a subscribed lane's board. A signal; the app drops it from the list.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.

payload.title: BookingUpdatedFrame
payload.description: Frame `booking_updated` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: BookingUpdated
data.description: Something on a haul changed besides its step; sent to the driver and the shipper without a subscription. A signal: the app reads the booking again.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.
